Darmoshark K8 Studio for Linux and Windows.

- A new native interface built with GPUI: no web view, faster start-up, light and dark themes.
- RGB effects, per-key colors, presets and onboard profiles.
- Key remapping (including Fn, profile and media actions) and hardware macros.
- Macro recording on Linux reads the K8 directly, so it works with any keyboard layout.
- 128×128 LCD photos and animated GIFs, with individual photo slots.
- Report rate, debounce, sleep and keyboard options, including OS auto-detection.
- Screen-color and audio-spectrum lighting with native capture on Linux and Windows.

Choose `.deb` or `.rpm` for Linux, the tarball for other distributions, or the
`.exe` for Windows x64. A working Vulkan driver is required on Linux. Tarball
users should install the included udev rule separately. `PKGBUILD` builds from
source on Arch Linux. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers the release files.

The AppImage and the Windows installer are no longer provided.
Windows keyboard functions have not yet been validated on a Windows PC.
